requirements: obtain written Cargo capability confirmation or separately approve a first-party edge
name one response-header owner and a rollback owner
confirm that Freight remains a separate response boundary
approve and operate a privacy-reviewed reporting endpoint
deliver CSP through Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only on every document route
inventory exact route-specific sources and Cargo editor or preview ancestors
collect a clean representative report window
verify compact and expanded routes, themes, faces, scales, shapes, rivers, media, and controls
verify V7, Touchbaes, and Montran interactions
verify desktop Chromium and Safari plus physical iPhone and iPad Safari
verify Cargo editor and preview framing
audit HTTPS redirect, TLS, DNS, subdomains, and rollback before HSTS expansion
promote the clean exact CSP to Content-Security-Policy
activate reviewed referrer, permissions, MIME, frame, and HTTPS headers on all document routes
capture fresh public response evidence and rerun the complete interaction matrix

promotion_gates: activation remains blocked while header_owner is null
activation remains blocked while reporting_endpoint is null
activation remains blocked while CSP exact_value is null
no meta tag may be credited as response-header enforcement
all three canonical document routes must change atomically
Freight response coverage must not be claimed by a first-party edge
Cargo editor and preview frame compatibility must be proven before frame enforcement
HSTS includeSubDomains and preload require a separate complete host audit and approval
Cargo reload and fresh public response verification are mandatory
protected visual and interaction contracts must remain unchanged
